N O T I FICATION
In continuation to Commission Result Notification No. PSC-R (A)109/2018
Dated 17il, June,2021, this is to inform all the eligible candidates who have qualified in the written
examination for the post of Junior Engineer (Mech./Elect.& Electronics, Telecommunications
and Computer Engineering) that the Commission has fixed the date of viva voce on 10th and
I lth st'2021
Therefore, all the eligible candidates are requested to submit the self-
attested photocopies of the following documents in Commission: -
1. Recent Passport Size Photograph
2. Matriculation Certificates (Class X) issued by Board for proof of Date of Birth
3. Class XII Certificate with Mark sheet
4. Diploma /Degree Certificate etc /Mark sheet issued by Assistant Registrar / Registrar /
Controller of Examination /Vice Chancellor of the concerned University to ascertain
Educational Qualifi cation.
5. APST Certificate for APST Candidates'
6. Intimation letter to HoD for those who are in regular service
All the documents have to be submitted within 15 (fifteen) days from
the issue of this Notification.
Candidates may download their Admit Card w.e.f 26'h July'2021
onwards from Commission website www. app s c online. in.
